To block an attacker's IP on **CI-SIM**, send a POST request to its `/admin/block` endpoint with a JSON body:

```bash
curl -X POST http://<ci-sim-host>:8080/admin/block \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"address": "<attacker-ip>"}'
```

The blocked source will receive **403 Forbidden** while other traffic continues.

To list currently blocked addresses:

```bash
curl http://<ci-sim-host>:8080/admin/blocks
```

To unblock an address:

```bash
curl -X POST http://<ci-sim-host>:8080/admin/unblock \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"address": "<attacker-ip>"}'
```

These admin endpoints are part of the CI-SIM service API (see its description in the repository).
